Greek style in Vietnam :)
Oct 2026 • Solo
Having lived among the world's largest Greek population outside of Greece (in Melbourne, Victoria) and having grown up around many Greek neighbours (who were also very skilled cooks!), I can attest to the fact that this place is truly a Ho Chi Minh City gem! The food is authentic, and the meat portions as generous as you would expect from any Greek restaurant! The cuisine is also very fresh, delicious and reasonably priced :) I will definitely eat here again.

This place is not Greek souvlaki at all……beyond terrible!
Feb 2024 • Family
Only thing Greek is the name on the sign. This place was a disgusting example of souvlaki or a Greek salad. My wife notice the terrible smell of the beef rich away. The meat, none of it is grill in the Greek tradition, on skewers. They fry it in a pan. The pita bread is fried in oil and not the traditional way. Nice we ate we all had the feeling of leftover cold grease in our mouth. This place was beyond terrible. But partially our fault as we thought we were at the Greek House which is just around the corner from this dump.

Delicious food - good value
Aug 2022
Visited in Aug 2022.

We discovered this restaurant by luck, to our surprise the food was excellent, good portions and excellent price.

The souvlaki wrap was delicious, the perfect ratio of chicken, salad, chips, and sauce. I dare to say that this restaurant serves better food than many others we have visited in Athens.

We ended eating here nearly every day while in this city.

The owner (Trang) is very friendly, she is certainly making the best Greek food in Nha Trang.

Highly recommended!
